name: Adoniram
title: Overseer of the forced labor under Solomon
summary: Adoniram, son of Abda, was in charge of the forced labor during the reigns of King David, Solomon, and Rehoboam. When Rehoboam sent him to subdue the rebellious northern tribes, he was stoned to death.

keyEvents.title: Stoned by the rebellious people
keyEvents.description: Rehoboam sent Adoniram, the overseer of the forced labor, to the northern tribes, but all Israel stoned him to death.
